sources.naming_precedence: Final meeting consensus section 7 freezes canonical names and supersedes role briefs. P0 registers no aliases.

maturity_definitions.existing_contract: Name and consumer/local tool contract exist at the pinned Drama baseline; not proof of a deployed Remote MCP handler.
maturity_definitions.planned_p0: Reserved by the Media P0 specification; planned/not yet proven implemented as an MCP tool. This freeze adds no handler.
maturity_definitions.planned_p1: New Drama command frozen by consolidation P0 for post-P0 implementation. This label is not a promise that all runtime work ships in wave P1; Story and Production depend on later waves.

implementation_status_definitions.adapter_contract_only: V10 narrow client port exists; server transport, authentication, Quote/Budget and full handler acceptance are not proven.
implementation_status_definitions.local_controlled_review_only: Opt-in DSH Stage 09 tool and controlled executor exist; no unified Remote MCP or durable Drama Run is implied.
implementation_status_definitions.planned_not_yet_proven_implemented: Specification/decision only for this public command; internal services may exist, but tool implementation and acceptance are not proven.

field_semantics.mutability: read does not mutate domain facts; write may append facts, create work or request a state transition. A read-only reviewer may still consume model tokens.
field_semantics.idempotency_required: Requires idempotency_key for writes under the named contract, not evidence of runtime enforcement. All new Drama writes require it; existing read-only Stage 09 keeps its current input.
field_semantics.expected_revision_required: Drama writes against existing project/target aggregates require expected_revision at commit time. Project creation, reads and unchanged Media contracts do not. Media internal concurrency controls are separate from this public field.
field_semantics.authorization_class: Policy class, not an implemented grant or client-supplied role. Media classes retain the P0 spec scope strings. Drama classes require authenticated Workspace/project/object authorization; membership alone never grants approval or spend authority.
field_semantics.async_result_kind: Identifies returned durable work handles or queried work facts. none means a direct result without a new async work handle. controlled_review_result is the existing awaited local reviewer result, not a durable creative run.

authorization_classes.workspace.project_create: Authenticated subject may create a project in this Workspace.
authorization_classes.project.read: Read authority for the project and each referenced object; apply to historical as well as current records.
authorization_classes.project.artifact_write: Create candidate/import revisions within an authorized project, without approval or media-state privileges.
authorization_classes.project.approval_revoke: Explicit revocation authority for this decision type and target; actor is derived from authentication.
authorization_classes.story.execute: Run the permitted Story step within a project and fixed input scope; no approval authority.
authorization_classes.story.review: Create independent planning review evidence; no approval or media submission authority.
authorization_classes.story.approve: Authorized human/delegated approver for the exact planning candidate, hash and evidence; model PASS is insufficient.
authorization_classes.script.write: Write a target episode using its approved Planning Baseline and fixed continuity inputs.
authorization_classes.script.review: Create Stage 04 evidence for a fixed screenplay version; no formal approval authority.
authorization_classes.script.approve: Authorized human/delegated approver for a same-version Script candidate with Doctor PASS and Continuity CLEAR.
authorization_classes.production.step_execute: Execute one allowlisted Stage 05-09 production step subject to its own prerequisites; no implicit approval or media submit.
authorization_classes.production.package_approve: Authorized approver for the typed asset_generation_plan or video_production_package; not spend authority.
authorization_classes.production.prepare_quote: Project production preparation authority plus media.quotes.create and applicable Workspace budget policy; cannot submit a Provider job.
authorization_classes.production.execute_spend: Project execution authority plus relevant media.generate.image/video scope and explicit Quote confirmation or valid bounded auditable Workspace preauthorization.
authorization_classes.production.result_adopt: Explicit project result-adoption authority over the precise candidate and target version; cannot change Media Job facts.
authorization_classes.production.controlled_review: Existing opt-in host-controlled Stage 09 policy and authenticated project read authority when composed; not Story review, approval or spend authority.
authorization_classes.media.models.read: Model catalog read scope; no Drama project dependency.
authorization_classes.media.assets.write: Media asset/upload write scope and Workspace/object ownership checks; no creative identity or approval writes.
authorization_classes.media.assets.read: Media asset read scope and Workspace/object access checks, including signed access URL issuance.
authorization_classes.media.quotes.create: Quote scope and Workspace budget authorization; no creative approval inference.
authorization_classes.media.generate.image: Image generation scope plus owned, unexpired, matching Quote and valid cost authorization.
authorization_classes.media.generate.video: Video generation scope plus owned, unexpired, matching Quote and valid cost authorization.
authorization_classes.media.jobs.read: Media Job read scope and Workspace/object access checks.
authorization_classes.media.jobs.cancel: Media Job cancellation scope and Workspace/object access checks; cancellation is not a refund or creative revocation.

async_result_kinds.none: Direct resource, list, version, approval or Quote result; no async handle is introduced.
async_result_kinds.creative_run_id: Accepted Drama creative work returns run_id; query with dramago_run_get.
async_result_kinds.creative_run_snapshot: Read a Drama creative run, its fixed inputs, steps, outputs and errors; do not query Media Job here.
async_result_kinds.execution_id: Return a persistent Drama production execution_id, with Quote or linked Media Job facts as applicable; query with dramago_production_execution_get.
async_result_kinds.execution_snapshot: Read an existing Drama execution, including historical/stale links; never create or resubmit work.
async_result_kinds.media_job_id: Return the existing Media job_id and status; query with job_get.
async_result_kinds.media_job_snapshot: Read an existing Media Job and output_asset_ids without creating work.
async_result_kinds.media_asset_id: Return asset_id with pending/processing/ready/rejected status as applicable; continue with asset_get, not dramago_run_get.
async_result_kinds.media_asset_snapshot: Read Media asset metadata/status and optionally an access URL without regenerating media.
async_result_kinds.controlled_review_result: Await the existing local reviewer and return provider, host run_id, estimated_tokens and structured findings. That host run_id is not yet a durable Drama creative Run.

policies.new_drama_write_idempotency: Persist a Workspace/project/command-scoped key and normalized request digest; identical retries recover the original result, changed payload conflicts. New project creation uses Workspace/command scope. Replay must not create new paid work.
policies.revision_control: Check expected_revision for existing Drama aggregates using transactional CAS. Immutable baselines are never edited; approval/revocation modifies pointers or appends decisions/events. Recheck current validity and revision before candidate binding.
policies.approval_identity: Derive approver from authenticated context; bind decisions to exact immutable candidate versions, hashes and review evidence. Client labels, imported APPROVED text and model PASS never grant authority.
policies.execution_recovery: Persist execution intent before external submission; recovery retains execution_id and original submission key. No automatic paid retry for unknown/reconciling, manifest edits or disconnects. Deliberate regeneration requires explicit generation_attempt and fresh cost authorization.
policies.media_boundary: Keep Media Core generic. Media tools require no Drama project_id, planning_baseline_id or Canon; generate_* never mutate Drama approval state. Authorized linkage may create a review_required Drama candidate; a separate explicit authorized decision adopts or rejects that candidate.
policies.compatibility: Preserve five Media tool names, input/output/error/async contracts, V10 adapter request keys and review_required semantics. Do not add media_* synonyms or rewrite integrations/media-mcp in P0.

tools.name: dramago_project_create
tools.invariant: Create one Workspace-owned project and declared planning scope; never equate Workspace with Project or manufacture approved baselines.

tools.name: dramago_project_get
tools.invariant: Return authorized project/episode scope, baseline references and blockers without advancing any stage.

tools.name: dramago_artifact_get
tools.invariant: Resolve an authorized artifact and requested immutable version; downstream execution pins version IDs and hashes rather than latest.

tools.name: dramago_artifact_revision_create
tools.invariant: Append a typed text/structured candidate or legacy_unverified import; CAS the existing project/target, never set approved, Job status or formal media bindings.

tools.name: dramago_baseline_get
tools.invariant: Return immutable Planning/Script manifests and evidence with separate validity events; revocation never rewrites a baseline.

tools.name: dramago_approval_get
tools.invariant: Read formal approval/rejection/revocation decisions separately from model reviews, budget authorization and Media success.

tools.name: dramago_approval_revoke
tools.invariant: Append an authorized revocation and impact events; block new downstream release without mutating frozen content or erasing in-flight Job/cost facts.

tools.name: dramago_run_get
tools.invariant: Query a creative run with fixed inputs, steps, outputs and errors; never reinterpret a Media job_id as a creative run_id.

tools.name: dramago_workbench_get
tools.invariant: Return a server-derived project projection retaining the us-vertical-drama-workbench/v1 production subview; imported ready labels grant no execution authority.

tools.name: dramago_story_step_run
tools.invariant: Run one allowlisted Story step and explicit scope on fixed inputs; never auto-advance, write a formal screenplay or approve its own output.

tools.name: dramago_planning_review
tools.invariant: Review the full declared planning scope and freeze evidence/candidate manifest with baseline_id; incomplete/timed-out review is not PASS and PASS is not approval.

tools.name: dramago_planning_baseline_approve
tools.invariant: Approve the exact reviewed candidate/hash only after complete outline coverage, correct ownership and no blockers; no missing/duplicate episodes or opportunistic scope shrink.

tools.name: dramago_script_draft
tools.invariant: Stage 03 writes the target episode from an approved planning_baseline_id, outline and required continuity versions; no latest substitution or invented unapproved core planning.

tools.name: dramago_script_review
tools.invariant: Stage 04 binds Doctor/Mandatory Fail evidence to the screenplay hash, then checks continuity after PASS; freeze a candidate, never grant formal approval.

tools.name: dramago_script_baseline_approve
tools.invariant: Freeze an episode Script Baseline for the same screenplay with Doctor PASS, Continuity CLEAR and authorized approval; CAS continuity and retain the immutable Planning reference.

tools.name: dramago_production_step_run
tools.invariant: Execute only an allowlisted 05-09 step with fixed upstream versions and per-step gates; Stage 08 stays creative compilation, not Provider submission or arbitrary state mutation.

tools.name: dramago_production_package_approve
tools.invariant: Approve an exact reviewed asset_generation_plan or video_production_package under distinct gates; neither can impersonate the other or authorize spending.

tools.name: dramago_production_generation_prepare
tools.invariant: Validate an approved typed plan and Script Baseline, persist execution intent, obtain Quote and return input digest/cost/expiry; never submit a Provider job.

tools.name: dramago_production_generate
tools.invariant: Submit only an existing execution_id after gate and Quote/budget authorization checks; repeat/recovery retains the original key/Job, while deliberate regeneration needs a new attempt and authorization.

tools.name: dramago_production_execution_get
tools.invariant: Query existing Job/Asset links, source versions, costs, stale and binding facts even when writeback is barred; no retry, regeneration or implicit adoption.

tools.name: dramago_production_result_review
tools.invariant: Adopt/reject a precise ready-media candidate after project/source/version/current-state checks; append Drama binding/decision only, never mutate Media Job or overwrite stale/approved targets.

tools.name: dramago_stage09_review
tools.invariant: Preserve opt-in, machine-QA PASS and explicit request/subjective-question trigger; one focused tool-free read-only reviewer, no parallel review, Story review, approval or media submission.

tools.name: quote_create
tools.invariant: Preserve Quote request/response and idempotency contract; Quote/budget reservation is not creative approval or proof that a Quote service is implemented.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.invariant: Keep generic image request, Quote confirmation and Media Job semantics without required Drama fields; generation never mutates Drama approval state.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.invariant: Keep generic video request, Quote confirmation and Media Job semantics without required Drama fields; generation never mutates Drama approval state.

tools.name: job_get
tools.invariant: job_get means Media Job, not creative Run; report actual status/output_asset_ids, and never turn unknown/reconciling into permission to resubmit.

tools.name: asset_get
tools.invariant: Read a generic Media Asset and optional access URL, not a Drama creative identity; URL expiry triggers URL refresh, never regeneration or approval.

tools.name: models_list
tools.invariant: Planned/not yet proven implemented: list permitted image/video capabilities, availability and pricing versions; catalog presence is not generation success.

tools.name: models_get
tools.invariant: Planned/not yet proven implemented: read public_model_id capability/input schema/limits; no Story/Canon dependencies or fabricated availability.

tools.name: asset_create_upload
tools.invariant: Planned/not yet proven implemented: create a scoped upload/import with controlled URL, inline bytes or upload session; no assumed chat attachment bridge or automatic Drama binding.

tools.name: asset_confirm
tools.invariant: Planned/not yet proven implemented: confirm an owned upload receipt and initiate validation/processing; confirmation is neither guaranteed ready nor creative adoption.

tools.name: job_cancel
tools.invariant: Planned/not yet proven implemented: request cancellation of an owned Media Job; cancel_requested is not terminal cancellation, refund or Drama approval revocation.
